# PortSwigger XSS cheat sheet payloads, extracted from
# https://portswigger.net/web-security/cross-site-scripting/cheat-sheet
# Lines are URL-decoded before use, like the libinjection corpus.
# Payloads the cheat sheet injects into a URL attribute, wrapped in the
# element the sheet uses so the detector sees the attribute.
